judgment_calls.decision: Header ("Give urgent attention to the patient with wheeze/tight chest") -> Urgent for every wheeze/tight chest; "Life threatening" tier -> Emergency; "Severe" tier -> Urgent (separate rule).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Severe as "Very urgent"; life threatening as "Very urgent".

judgment_calls.decision: (and Tight chest (no Wheezing)) per the page's own parenthesis, plus a task asking about wheeze when tight chest is recorded.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Absent breath sounds (finding), the usual clinical meaning, which the page does not state.

judgment_calls.decision: Only orthopnea and leg swelling branch encoded; "patient >= 50 years with first episode" omitted (no age comparison in the language). Rule fires less often than the page intends.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Encode first episode without age (would fire more often; rejected).

judgment_calls.decision: Bullet 1 encoded as a possible anaphylaxis diagnosis (sudden wheeze/tight chest AND any listed feature) so page 28 checks fire.
